component.name: MinbarLive
component.summary: Real-time Islamic live translation and subtitles

description.p: MinbarLive transcribes live speech and projects translated subtitles, built for khutbahs and lectures. Audio is captured from a microphone or the system's own output, transcribed, and translated into a full-screen subtitle overlay that can be shown on a projector or captured by OBS.

Quran verses and Athan phrases are recognised and rendered from curated published translations rather than being paraphrased by a model. Pre-recorded recordings can be turned into subtitle files in batch mode.
The Linux build is experimental. Several features are Windows-only, and storing API keys between sessions needs a Secret Service keyring backend.
